# Slime crystal recipe unlock fixtures

Original generated advancement JSON from Tinkers’ Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`, under
`src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/`.

- `building_blocks/common/slime/{earth,sky,ichor,ender}/crystal_block.json`
- `misc/common/slime/{earth,sky,ichor,ender}/crystal_growing.json`
- `misc/common/slime/{earth,sky,ichor,ender}/crystal_smelting.json`

File bytes are unchanged and recorded in `sha256.json`. The native copies
map the recipe rewards and recipe-unlocked predicate to the existing flattened
recipe IDs, and use the host's `recipes` predicate key.

Source: https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2
License: `tconstruct/third_party/tconstruct/LICENSE`.
